observations: EventIndexStore.Search executes bounded local timeline queries with MaxResults, MaxScanEvents, ExpandDepth, MaxExpandDegree, and MaxVisitedNodes caps, producing explicit truncated/deadline_exceeded/canceled termination status alongside deterministic canonical ResultDigest.

Cyclic cross-event links terminate immediately via visited-node tracking with CycleDetected and explicit TruncationReason without unbounded traversal, and high-degree hub expansions stop cleanly at MaxExpandDegree.

Request bounds exceeding hard caps reject with ErrQueryLimitExceeded; negative timeouts or malformed time ranges reject with ErrInvalidInput; unavailable remote providers reject with ErrUnavailableProvider; expired deadlines and canceled contexts return ErrQueryDeadlineExceeded and ErrQueryCanceled with matching termination status.

EventIndexStore.RebuildCaseIndex deterministically discovers or accepts verified C16 derived artifacts, verifies each against ArtifactStore and SealStore, normalizes timestamps via C17 rules, deduplicates stable EventIdentity rows, replaces case index files atomically with crash-staging cleanup on reopen, and matches original search ResultDigest.

Reordered artifact sets yield identical ResultDigest while mutated semantic facts yield distinct EventIdentity and distinct ResultDigest; sealed source evidence blobs remain byte-identical across rebuilds and queries.
